1. [RARC.5.6.2] Takes the input the call carries: a fact to assert or
   retract, or a new clock value.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_2__step
idris.note: What a fixture issues to the clocked loop: an input of this clause -- a data event or a clock move, Rete/TtlSweep.idr's `Rarc_5_6_2__input` -- or a pump under a fuel.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_2__run_steps_ttl
idris.note: The steps in order on Rete/TtlSweep.idr's clocked engine: each input taken through the loop's steps before firing, each pump through its run.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_2__run_steps_ttl_net
idris.note: The same steps on the clocked network engine, as Fixture.idr runs them.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__steps_ttl_agree
idris.note: ANY SEQUENCE OF INPUTS, TICKS AND PUMPS keeps the agreement of the network with FireLoop, with one deadline table and one clock on both sides: each input agrees, each pump agrees.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_2__input
idris.note: The input a call carries: a new clock value (`clock_ns`), or a data event of Rete/PumpBoundary.idr, a fact to assert or retract. A pump carries none; it is the run that follows an input (Rete/PumpBoundary.idr's boundary, Rete/NetworkTraced.idr's cadence).

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_2__input_in_dom
idris.note: A tick carries no value; a data event's value lies in the domain.
